candidates.candidateFocus: Present status of a contemplated action
semanticRelations: A person states that an action is under consideration.
The current undecided status is expressed without competing interpretations.
candidates.decisionBasis: The uncertainty is the clearly stated user state rather than uncertainty in interpretation.

semanticRelations: One statement presents an action as a suggestion.
The available relations do not establish whether the suggestion became an adopted plan.
candidates.decisionBasis: The currently applicable commitment status is not established.

semanticRelations: Two statements support incompatible current states.
Neither statement retracts the other or establishes precedence.
candidates.decisionBasis: The available relations leave current-state precedence unresolved.

semanticRelations: The target uses a context-dependent reference.
More than one antecedent remains materially possible.
candidates.decisionBasis: The target referent cannot be selected from the stated relations.

candidates.candidateFocus: Meaning of a deliberate approximate range
semanticRelations: A single state is expressed as an approximate range.
No incompatible alternative state is introduced.
Approximation is part of the resolved meaning.
candidates.decisionBasis: Approximation alone does not create interpretive ambiguity.

semanticRelations: The content is explicitly introduced as an example.
Its non-actual status is established without a competing reading.
candidates.decisionBasis: Clearly example-only content has a resolved interpretation even though it is not user state.
